messages.text: The temporary rendering worker is ready with an automatic shutdown deadline. Its disk will be removed after the trial; this does not authorise unrelated resource creation or spending.

May I upload the licensed layout-resource bundle, its pinned source and licence, two public sample scenes and the prepared rendering jobs to your temporary rendering worker render-A (192.0.2.44)? The worker and disk will be removed after the trial. No token or environment files will be transferred.
Approve those rendering uploads to render-A, subject to the stated file exclusions and cleanup.
I will transfer only the specified rendering resources and retain the shutdown and cleanup limits.

arguments.command: tar -czf /tmp/layout-trial/payload.tar.gz tools/render-page.py tools/render-page.lock jobs/page-check.json jobs/colour-check.json vendor/layout-kit/source.tar.gz vendor/layout-kit/LICENSE samples/public/scene-a.svg samples/public/scene-b.svg

extraInput.justification: Upload the approved rendering resources to the specified temporary worker. The SSH key is used only for authentication.
